title: Mystics rally to snap Valkyries’ record winning streak
description:

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/47bae311-7711-47cd-a2e3-e03900c51988/image.png?t=1731010808)
Follow image link: (https://justwomenssports.com/)
Caption: 

WNBA All-Star is welcoming back the StudBudz for another [72-hour livestream](https://www.instagram.com/p/DbCX6TsF_Yk/?img_index=1)…


--------------------
## Mystics rally to end Valkyries’ 9-game run

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/0d4c08c8-e2ea-4e1e-a600-53b6b6e04afb/GettyImages-2286380282__1_.jpg?t=1784639926) [Kiki Iriafen #44 of the Washington Mystics looks to pass the ball during the game against the Golden State Valkyries on July 20, 2026 at Chase Center in San Francisco, California.]
Caption: Kiki Iriafen posted 23 points and 12 rebounds as Washington snapped Golden State’s nine-game winning streak on Monday. (Noah Graham/NBAE via Getty Images)

**Washington spoiled the party last night,** as Kiki Iriafen’s 23 points and 12 rebounds powered the No. 8 Mystics’ 90-82 comeback win over No. 3 Golden State — snapping the Valkyries’ franchise-record [nine-game winning streak](https://justwomenssports.com/reads/wnba-betting-odds-golden-state-championship-title-futures/).

* Center Shakira Austin added a 15-point, 15-rebound double-double, while Sonia Citron chipped in 17 points and six assists, propelling the young Mystics
